interface.shortDescription: ahood's registry MCP tools, plus a skill for your dashboard, updates, reviews and snaps
interface.longDescription: ahood (ahood.dev) is a registry for AI agent skills, agents, MCP servers and docs, with versioning, private session notes (snaps) and owner-approved self-evolution. This plugin wires up ahood's hosted MCP server (it reads your token from $AHOOD_TOKEN) and bundles two skills: `ahood`, a dashboard of installed skills that syncs updates and reviews evolution proposals only with your consent, and `using-ahood`, how to search, install and snap from inside a session.
